crossRefs.note: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf…

people.name: Hazeroth
people.line: Israelite encampment during the wilderness wanderings

people.name: Kibroth-hattaavah
people.line: A place where the Israelites complained and were punished

translations.web: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
translations.bsb: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth, where they remained for some time.
translations.kjv: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
translations.asv: From Kibrothhattaavah the people journeyed unto Hazeroth; and they abode at Hazeroth.
